analysis.is_complaint_reason: The customer expresses dissatisfaction, wants her £4,250 back, and alleges financial loss from an APP scam. The bank also failed to refer the case to the fraud team (CH-1).
analysis.summary: Ms [PERSON_2], aged 78 and widowed last year, was tricked by a fake HMRC text and a call from a fraudster posing as Harbourline security. She moved £4,250 by Faster Payment on 12/09 to an account in the name of [PERSON_1]. On 14/09 the card was blocked and online banking credentials were reset, but no fraud team referral was made. She chased on 30/09 and the case still had no fraud owner on 21/10. She wants her money back and asks for large-print letters. The case is flagged Critical with 0 days left.

timeline.event: Customer transferred £4,250 by FPS at 14:32 to an account in the name of [PERSON_1] after a fake HMRC text and a call from a fraudster claiming to be Harbourline security.
Customer phoned the bank, very distressed. Card blocked, online banking credentials reset, identity verified. Customer told the fraud team would be in touch.
Customer chased. No record of a fraud team referral. Apology given. Customer asked for large-print letters.
Internal chase. Still no fraud team owner.

analysis.severity_reason: Suspected scam with a loss of £4,250, above £1,000, and a possibly vulnerable elderly customer, so High under CH-6. The fraud referral has also been delayed by over a month.

vulnerability.suggested_support: Refer to Vulnerable Customer Support. Send large-print letters and agree a contact method and named contact. Sensitively ask whether she needs any support. Her age and low confidence with online banking suggest possible capability and health considerations. Check whether any third-party authority exists before involving anyone else.

analysis.routing_reason: APP scam goes to Fraud & Scams (ESC-1, FRD-2), and the 1-business-day handover deadline was missed. A vulnerability indicator (bereavement, low capability) combined with the scam loss means a VUL-4 referral to Vulnerable Customer Support. Senior Complaints Review is suggested for the missed referral and the prolonged delay. This is a judgement for the handler to confirm.
